get_rows_from_dataset: get rows from a HuggingFace dataset split in streaming or normal mode with a max row limit
get_rows_or_raise_with_fallback: get rows from a dataset split trying streaming first then falling back to normal download mode
create_branch_on_hub: create a new branch on a HuggingFace dataset repository using the HfApi client
check_config_and_split_exists: check if a given config or split exists for a HuggingFace dataset using cached step responses
get_file_extension_recursive: get the file extension of a filename handling double extensions like tar.gz and cleaning special characters
